usefulness.rationale: Judge assessment reached the overclaim response limit of 40; further findings may be omitted. The dossier establishes who Cristiano Amon is (Brazilian electrical engineer, UNICAMP graduate, Qualcomm CEO since 2021) and his career arc (NEC Brazil, joined Qualcomm 1995/1996, left for Ericsson/VC, rejoined 2004, President 2018, CEO 2021, Nuvia acquisition, diversification into PCs/automotive/robotics/data center). However, the dossier is heavily polluted with contested placeholder claims ('statement', 'Cristiano Amon', 'Qualcomm') and conflicting details (joined 1995 vs hired 1996; 'no affiliation in this record'), which muddies the picture. It does convey his actual accomplishments but with noise and unresolved conflicts.
